name: async-offramp
description: Take a request that cannot finish on this call and work on it after the call. Voice-only — not available on text turns. Use after the principal agrees to a follow-up, or when the ask clearly needs more time (deep research, bulk triage, multi-document drafting, clarification loops). Anything the caller wants emailed or messaged after the call, such as links or research results, goes here: you cannot send on the call. A recap of this call is meeting-notes-start, not this tool. Provide a crisp brief of what to do and how to follow up (signal or email). Returns accepted:true only when the work was actually enqueued — never claim a follow-up on failure. Tell the caller as a person would, for example "I'll work on that after we hang up and email it to you." This tool and whoever picks the work up stay unspoken.

inputs.brief: string (required — crisp description of the work to do asynchronously)
inputs.follow_up_channel: string? (signal | email — channel to reach the principal when done; defaults to email)
inputs.idempotency_key: string? (optional stable key; duplicates return the prior enqueue without spawning another task)

outputs.accepted: boolean (true when the async coordinator task was enqueued or deduplicated)
outputs.task_event_id: string? (bus event id of the enqueued agent.task)
outputs.deduplicated: boolean? (true when this call reused a prior enqueue)
outputs.note: string? (short status for the spoken confirm)
